findings.summary: The parseUnifiedDiff function stores only the last hunk per file because it uses the file path as the map key, dropping all previous hunks and breaking diff stats and deduplication.
findings.suggested_fix: Change ParsedUnifiedDiff.hunks to store an array of hunks per file (e.g., ReadonlyMap<string, ParsedHunk[]>), and append to this array instead of overwriting the map value.

findings.summary: findHunkForLine unconditionally returns a hunk even if the comment line does not fall within the hunk's line range, leaking unrelated diff context.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the unconditional `return hunk;` at the end of findHunkForLine and return `undefined` if the line does not match the range.

findings.summary: extractSymbolFromLine only matches capitalized words, failing to extract lowercase function or variable names as symbols.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the regex in extractSymbolFromLine to `/\b([a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*)\b/` to match all valid TypeScript identifiers.

findings.summary: findDeclaration uses a regex anchored to the start of the line (^), which fails to find indented declarations or methods inside classes.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the `^` anchor from DECLARATION_PATTERN so it can match indented declarations.
